equipment_id.description: Identifier of one of the caller's units this policy applies to. The platform-wide default policy is managed by configuration and cannot be changed here.

sustained_excursion_minutes.description: Minutes an out-of-range reading must persist before an alert opens

hysteresis_margin_celsius.description: Margin, in Celsius, a reading must re-enter range by before the alert closes; at least 1.0, the resolution of the DHT11 sensor

missed_sync_windows_for_offline.description: Number of missed synchronization windows before a device is considered offline
